notes: The three selected units (v035, v036, v037) all carry readings the ASV realizes in full.

ταῦτα has already written the antecedent the relative clause is predicated of, so rule 32's apposition clause empties the article before μέλλοντα and the participle keeps the relativizer; a reference comparison will report that article as a disagreement without that being a correction.
ἔμπροσθεν is rendered by the single word before, so rule 71's frame question does not arise.
The repeated infinitival to before stand is a rule 7 helper on the verb it introduces under rule 103, never added.
